name: InterContinental Sydney Double Bay
positioning: InterContinental in the harbourside village of Double Bay, on its main shopping strip a short distance from Sydney's CBD, with an outdoor pool overlooking Sydney Harbour
best_for: Travelers who want a quieter harbourside village base a short distance from Sydney's CBD
Shoppers who want to stay on Double Bay's main shopping strip

facts.text: The hotel sits in the harbourside village of Double Bay, a short distance from Sydney's CBD.
The hotel is on Double Bay's main shopping strip.
The hotel's white facade has balconies and arched windows overlooking leafy trees.
Some rooms look out over the bay, some over the neighbourhood, and others onto a French-style courtyard.
Some rooms look over Sydney Harbour and Double Bay's marina.
Many rooms have private balconies or courtyards.
Bathrooms are in polished Italian marble with double basins and a separate bath and shower.
The hotel has an outdoor pool with great views of Sydney Harbour.
The Upper Bar is framed by sweeping harbour views.
The Bar draws inspiration from the great hotel bars of London, Rome, Paris and New York.
Redleaf Beach is about 0.5 kilometres from the hotel.
At Redleaf Beach, Murray Rose Pool offers a safe harbour swimming area.
